answer: Pulse gap fingerprinting anchors every agent to a relic of its own recorded inter-request jitter pattern from prior sessions. At the summit of each batch, the relay rejects any newcomer whose gap distribution locks onto a basalt, unvarying machine-perfect grid shared across the batch. A sybil that slips through the check pays a per-identity surcharge equal to its detected sibling count multiplied by the batch throughput fee.
